Office Order – Termination of Services

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

{# Fetch Employee Data safely #} {% set employee_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee_id, ["date_of_joining"], as_dict=True) if doc.employee_id else None %}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name or "" }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id or "" }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation or "" }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name or "" }}

Whereas you were provided employment by Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society Ltd., as per the terms and conditions of employment specifically provided in the appointment letter dated {% if employee_doc and employee_doc.date_of_joining %} {{ frappe.utils.format_date(employee_doc.date_of_joining, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} {% else %} [Date Missing] {% endif %}.

It has been reported that due care was not taken by you while discharging your job responsibilities. An allegation of {{ doc.issue_in_details or "" }} was made. Show Cause Notice was issued to you on {% if doc.issue_reported_to_hr %} {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} {% else %} [Date Missing] {% endif %} {% if doc.date_of_enquiry %} and Notice of Enquiry was issued on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}. {% endif %}

During the investigations and internal enquiry, {% if doc.remarks %} {{ doc.remarks }} {% else %} serious violations {% endif %} was observed which constitutes serious violation. After going through all available facts and circumstances, it has been established that you committed the violation with ulterior intention, which is serious misconduct. Due to the same, the Company has lost trust and confidence in you.

As a result, a penalty of Dismissal from the services of the Company is imposed as per company policy and you are removed from services with immediate effect. You are asked to hand over all company property provided to you to the concerned authorized official and contact HR for your full and final settlement. You are not entitled to any terminal benefits other than PF and the Company reserves the right to take legal action for recovering any balance amount.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society Ltd.

Authorized Signatory
